content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Traditional platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad provide services that many digital creators need, such as payment processing and product delivery. However, they come with strict eligibility requirements and geographic restrictions. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure like the Edge Commerce Stack offers a complete solution that combines free hosting, automated payment processing, and immediate product delivery without the barriers imposed by conventional systems. With our infrastructure, creators can build an online store that functions independently of third-party restrictions, ensuring they can sell their products to a global audience.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, and similar platforms impose geographic restrictions that effectively exclude millions of potential sellers. For instance, PayPal's punitive measures like account suspensions can trap funds for up to 180 days without recourse, making it a risky option for creators in restricted countries. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to operate globally without the same limitations. By leveraging tools that are inherently accessible — such as Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments — creators can establish a fully operational online store that sidesteps these restrictions entirely, allowing them to focus on their craft rather than worrying about payment access.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processors like Stripe and PayPal often charge high fees and impose delays, especially for accounts in restricted countries. This means that even when transactions go through, creators face hidden costs and slow access to their funds. In stark contrast, the sovereign commerce infrastructure offers low transaction fees, typically around 0.5%, with immediate payment verification through NOWPayments. Transactions processed on networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON can cost under $0.10, making this approach not only more efficient but also more profitable for creators. This added financial efficiency empowers creators to invest more in their businesses and reach their audiences effectively.
Sovereign infrastructure means true ownership and independence.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When using conventional platforms, creators often rent their infrastructure, facing ongoing fees and limitations on their data ownership. With sovereign commerce infrastructure, once deployed, creators own everything — from the source code to the payment processing mechanisms. This architecture ensures that creators are not beholden to platform dependencies, providing them with freedom and control. Automation throughout the payment and delivery processes means that once a customer completes a purchase, they receive their product instantaneously. This not only enhances customer satisfaction but also allows creators to operate their businesses with minimal overhead.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a creator. If you require a quick deployment with essential features, the Sovereign Starter Stack may suffice. For those needing additional capabilities and scalability, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal, providing a comprehensive solution with five products loaded and end-to-end testing included. This stack also comes with 30 days of support, ensuring you have a reliable launch into the digital marketplace. Evaluate your product range and expected growth to determine which stack aligns best with your goals.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
PayPal's restrictions can trap your funds — choose freedom.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
